answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable stake behind one verifiable identity before trading. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs real capital, not just code: each clone must post its own stake, and misbehavior slashes it. Honest agents build reputation like a pearl forming layer by layer, while cheap copies sink without trace in the ocean of verified participants. Reaching the summit of trust, high-value contracts and voting weight, needs a long history of successful work, so an attacker cannot buy instant influence.
